sections.text: | Status | Meaning and next action | | --- | --- | | Draft request | An organization or department administrator can continue editing or withdraw the request. | | Submitted for quote | Phaeno is reviewing the submitted revision. | | Changes requested | Open the Job, correct the identified items, and submit the revised pricing profile. | | Quote in preparation | Phaeno is preparing pricing. No quote acceptance is available yet. | | Quote issued | An administrator can accept the current, unexpired quote for the selected Department. | | Placed, awaiting samples | Enter or import and finalize the exact sample list, then follow the Job's shipping instructions. | | In progress | Review individual samples for progress. | | Results available | Review Files and results for the packages released to you. | | On hold | Read the reason and complete the requested action or contact Phaeno. | | Cancellation requested | Phaeno is reviewing the request; work is not automatically cancelled. | | Completed | Work is complete. Results remain subject to the retention dates on each release. | | Cancelled or declined | Review the history and any linked commercial adjustment. |

sections.heading: Sample and result progress
sections.text: Expected, Received, and Accessioned track intake. Lab analysis and Data processing track scientific work. Sample progress alone does not make a file downloadable. The complete output package must pass its file checks and scientific review, then a Result Release Manager publishes it. Use the Job's Files and results section to review the sample, package version, files, and download availability. A withdrawn or quarantined package is unavailable even if processing finished. Downloads closed means the retention access window ended; it does not prove that stored files were deleted.

sections.heading: Quotes and invoices
sections.text: Issued means the current quote is available for review. Superseded means a newer quote replaced it. Expired means its validity period ended; request a current quote. Accepted records agreement to the price and scope and opens sample-list entry. Finalizing the exact compliant roster authorizes laboratory work and creates the shared shipment. The Job's Quote and billing section shows issued invoices, due dates, balances, and Download invoice PDF. Contact Phaeno about billing or a recorded payment; the Portal does not collect card payments. An unpaid invoice does not hold back scientifically released PSeq results. See Results and billing.

sections.heading: Recover a missing record or failed action
sections.text: Confirm the organization and selected Department in the header. On Lab services, clear search, status, date, or Submitted by me filters before assuming a Job is missing. A loading failure has its own retry action and differs from no matching Jobs. Open the Job and inspect the affected sample and Files and results. Results may still be processing, under scientific review, awaiting publication, withdrawn, or outside their retention window. For sample-list errors, correct the named row or source-group count. After changing a CSV, preview it again before replacing the draft list. A failed finalization does not authorize shipment; correct the problem and retry from the same Job. If the Job changed during an edit, review the refreshed record and preserved entries. A pricing submission clears its privacy confirmation so you can review and confirm the updated Job before resubmitting. For a failed download, retry once while the package remains available. If it fails again, contact Phaeno with the Job number, coded sample reference, file or package version, visible status, and time. Do not send credentials, patient identifiers, or scientific file contents in support messages.

guides.title: Trial history
guides.summary: Find preserved Trial scope, results, and retention receipts after conversion.

sections.heading: Trial history after Customer conversion
sections.text: If your organization previously completed a Prospect Trial Project, Trial projects retains its approved scope, samples, customer-safe progress, results, and history in the original department. Active authorized members may view it. The same organization identity continues after Customer conversion. For Research Use Only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures. Trial result archives include a manifest identifying the approved scope and files. Do not enter or send PHI or sample identity mappings through this workflow. Conversion does not reopen a Trial or permit additional Trial submissions. Use the Customer laboratory-request workflow for new work. Trial results remain independent of Customer invoice, credit, or payment status. Use Retention and receipt to review the release's original file policy and download history. Conversion does not restart or extend warning, retention, or grace dates. After complete release, earlier partial archives direct you to the complete package. Download controls show progress and explain unavailable files, including closed retention access; the workspace refreshes after a transfer. Withdrawn, held, or deleted files remain unavailable; retained metadata is not a promise of byte restoration. Contact Phaeno with the Trial number if a reissue is needed.

guides.title: Account and access
guides.summary: Accept invitations, protect sign-in, select a Department, and manage access within organization and Department roles.

sections.heading: Account and access
sections.text: An organization administrator is optional. A Company can operate through administrators of its active Departments. Department administrators act only within their assigned Departments; ask Phaeno to handle company-wide setup, invitations or roles when no organization administrator is available. Your Portal access is created through an invitation to a specific Partner organization. The current organization, selected Department, and your role determine which Lab Service, Kit, assembly, data, and administrative actions are available.

sections.heading: Accept an invitation
sections.text: Open the newest invitation link sent for your Partner organization. Review your name, organization, invited email, and Access after acceptance on the invitation page. Select Continue with your email. This goes directly to verification for the invited address; the email cannot be edited. Complete any required password or authenticator steps. Portal then returns you to the invitation for review and acceptance. Select Accept invitation to join, or Decline invitation. Known names do not need to be entered again. After accepting, the welcome message confirms your organization. Select Open Portal to continue. When creating your password, enter it once and use Show password or Hide password to check your entry. The invitation page shows the email address currently signed in. If it is not the invited email, choose Switch account, then sign in with the correct account. The invitation remains available in that browser while you switch accounts, and the identity service returns you to the invitation page after sign-in or account creation. Invitation links are private. A link can expire, be revoked, or be replaced by a newer invitation. If it is unavailable, ask your Partner administrator or Phaeno to send a new invitation. The identity service handles password verification and recovery. Complete the secure sign-in steps shown in Portal, and use Forgot password? when offered to recover access. Phaeno can adjust the proposed Organization role or Department access on your existing pending invitation. The same link remains valid until its original expiry; changing access does not send another invitation. If the access changes after you review it, Portal displays the updated access and asks you to select Accept invitation again. An expired invitation must be resent before it can be accepted. Once your membership is active, authorized role and Department-access changes apply immediately. You receive an informational email and do not need to accept another invitation. A deactivated membership still requires a fresh invitation and acceptance to restore access.

sections.heading: Protect your account
sections.text: After your first sign-in step, connect an authenticator app and confirm the code it displays. Save the one-time backup codes shown during setup somewhere private and separate from the device running the authenticator. Never send an authenticator or backup code to Phaeno or your Partner administrator. If you lose the authenticator but still have a backup code, use that code to sign in, then contact Phaeno to reset the authenticator enrollment. If you lose both the authenticator and every backup code, contact Phaeno directly. Phaeno will verify your identity and Partner organization before resetting MFA; all active sessions are revoked and you must connect a new authenticator before Portal access resumes. Email can start the support request but does not itself bypass MFA.

sections.heading: Confirm the current Partner organization
sections.text: The header shows the organization active in your current session. That organization controls the offerings, negotiated prices, addresses, orders, assembly requests, data grants, and users you can see. Self-service switching between multiple external organization memberships is not currently available. If the wrong organization is shown, stop before opening or creating work and contact Phaeno. Information and commercial terms never carry from one Partner organization to another.

sections.heading: Work within a department
sections.text: The header identifies your current organization and department. If you have access to more than one department, open the user menu and choose Department before opening or creating work. With a single available department, it is selected for you. Changing departments closes the previous workspace; finish or save your work before switching. Your selected department is remembered when you refresh this browser. If that department is no longer available, Portal selects an available department after checking your current access. Signing out clears the remembered selection. Members see only their assigned departments. Organization administrators can select any active department in their organization, but the selected department still determines the records displayed. A department administrator's operational authority applies only to that department; it is not organization-wide access. Organization-wide data grants may be available in each department. If a department is unavailable or an expected Partner record is missing, ask your organization administrator or Phaeno to review the assignment. Do not change URLs to try to access another department. Organization and department administrators can open Departments from the user menu to manage the departments within their authority.

sections.heading: Manage department access and settings
sections.text: When adding a department, enter its name and optional settings. The system assigns a reference such as DEPT-000123 when you save; you do not enter a Code. References are unique within the organization and stay the same when a department is renamed or deactivated. The department name remains its main label. Existing references, including GENERAL, are retained and shown as read-only context when editing. Organization administrators manage all departments, organization defaults, the default department, and department lifecycle. Department administrators manage settings and member access only in their assigned departments. A person can be an administrator in Research and a member in Operations; granting one department role does not grant organization-wide administrator rights. In Departments, use a department's actions menu to Edit settings or Manage members. To add an existing organization member, enter their exact email, choose Find member, and review the access change before confirming. Only an organization administrator can invite someone new through User management or change an organization role. Organization administrators already have access to every department and cannot be restricted by a department admin. An active member must retain at least one active department assignment. Organization administrators use Edit organization defaults to set the purchase-order rule, billing and notification email, and shipping and result instructions. A department override takes precedence; a blank override inherits the organization value, then the existing system or commercial fallback. Saved shipping and accepted-quote snapshots retain their recorded values. Result instructions do not change the storage destination or grant an ordering service. Invitations require reviewed department access for members. Select each department and grant its administrator role only when needed. Organization administrators receive access to every department, including future additions. If settings changed while you were editing, review your preserved entries against the latest version before saving again. Closing an unsaved form asks whether to discard the changes.

sections.heading: Understand roles
sections.text: Member can review the current Partner’s work and download files that have been released. Organization administrator can also place reagent orders, submit assembly requests, accept quotes or eligible commercial changes, request cancellations, approve substitutions, and manage membership. Department administrators have the applicable operational authority only within their assigned departments.

sections.heading: Manage Partner members
sections.text: Partner organization administrators manage membership only for their current organization. In User management, active members and invited people appear in one list. A Pending invitation status means the invitation has not been accepted and the offered access is not active. The person may already have a sign-in account. Use the card’s actions menu to resend or revoke that invitation, edit an active member’s organization role, or deactivate another member’s membership. An administrator cannot deactivate their own membership from User management. Enter the person’s first name, last name, and exact sign-in email, but never copy or request an invitation token. A deactivated membership is restored only through a fresh invitation and acceptance. Contact Phaeno for a globally disabled account or an action the organization administrator cannot complete. For a Member invitation, select at least one Department. If you clear all Departments and select Send invitation, the form returns focus to Department access and explains what to select. Your entries are retained and no invitation is sent until the required information is valid.

sections.heading: Resolve common access states
sections.text: | What you see | What to do | | --- | --- | | Access unavailable after sign-in | Choose Continue invitation if it is shown, then review and accept the saved invitation. Otherwise, sign out and reopen the newest invitation link. | | Invitation link unavailable | Ask an administrator to confirm it is pending and resend it. Use only the newest link. | | Email does not match | Sign in with the invited email or request a corrected invitation. | | No active memberships | Ask your Partner administrator to coordinate a fresh invitation with Phaeno. | | Wrong organization shown | Stop before opening records and contact Phaeno to verify the active membership. | | Organization unavailable | Ask Phaeno whether the organization is inactive. | | Account disabled | Contact Phaeno; a Partner administrator cannot override this state. | | Authenticator lost, backup code available | Use one backup code to sign in, then contact Phaeno for an MFA reset. | | Authenticator and backup codes lost | Contact Phaeno for identity verification and an MFA reset. Do not send old codes. | | Offering or action missing | Confirm the current organization, then ask an administrator to review your role or Phaeno to review Partner eligibility. | Never send a password, sign-in code, invitation token, or browser storage value in a support message.

sections.heading: Prepare work and commit a purchase
sections.text: Organization and Department administrators may prepare drafts and perform permitted operational actions within their selected Department. Organization and assigned-Department administrators may place configured Lab Service or PSeq Kit purchases and send custom-work requests to Sales for that Department. These rules do not widen access to another Department or Partner. Existing manual-quote actions retain their displayed permissions.

guides.title: Data Library, billing, and organization access
guides.summary: Use curated data, understand commercial records, and manage Partner membership.
taskKeywords: Data Library, billing, and organization access

sections.heading: Data Library, billing, and organization access
sections.text: Partner access is divided among curated Phaeno data, operational Partner work, commercial records, and organization membership.

sections.heading: Use curated data
sections.text: The Data Library contains exact package versions that Phaeno explicitly granted across your Partner organization or to your selected department. Active members can review the package summary, quality information, manifest, and checksums, then download individual files or a complete archive. Packages are read-only and remain separate from reagent and data-assembly records. A later package version does not replace an existing grant automatically. Phaeno may revoke or quarantine access. Those actions block new portal viewing and downloads but cannot recall files already downloaded. Partner administrators receive safe follow-up guidance when action on prior downloads is required.

sections.heading: Understand commercial documents
sections.text: Portal preserves immutable quotes and commercial source records. Phaeno Finance prepares journal entries and invoices through a manual accounting handoff outside the Partner workspace. The portal does not collect payment-card information or provide hosted payment links. Reagent pricing is negotiated per Partner and snapshotted when an order is placed. Data-assembly pricing is per job through an immutable quote. Assembly credit status is a separate audited setting that determines Net 30 or paid-before-download release.

sections.heading: Manage the Partner team
sections.text: Organization administrators use User management to invite people, review Department access, and manage organization membership. Department administrators use Departments for member access and settings within their assigned Departments. See Account and access for the role boundaries and invitation steps. The User management screen saves invitations, eligible role changes, and membership deactivation to the Portal account system. Membership deactivation preserves historical actions, and a fresh invitation is required for reactivation. Phaeno administrators control global account and organization status. Organization and department administrators can review curated download history for the selected department. This includes downloads from packages shared across the organization. Organization administrators can switch departments to review each department's activity. Department administrators see only activity within their assigned departments. Older download records without a recorded department remain available only to organization administrators, for organization-wide grants or grants assigned to the selected department. Changing a person's department assignments does not move or erase their earlier download records. Operational downloads and order exports remain scoped to the selected Partner and department, with the applicable release gate for downloads. Safety and withdrawal instructions about previously supplied data continue to go to current organization administrators during an organization suspension. These notices do not restore Portal access. Contact Phaeno if you cannot record a required response in the portal.

guides.title: Prepare included Assembly
guides.summary: Prepare a purchased Kit case, correct inputs and download governed outputs without another purchase.

sections.heading: Included assembly inputs and outputs
sections.text: Each purchased PSeq Kit unit includes one assembly case. Organization and Department administrators prepare its files and metadata within the selected Department. The case belongs to your Partner organization; Portal does not collect the downstream customer's identity.

sections.heading: Prepare an included case
sections.text: Open PSeq Kit orders, select the order, and find Included assembly cases. After the kit is shipped, select Prepare inputs on the intended case. Check its kit label, lot and submission deadline. Enter the Partner project or reference and required metadata. Review the read-only included profile and outputs. These are frozen from purchase and cannot be replaced with another catalog profile. Choose allowed input files within the displayed per-file and total limits, and confirm the prohibited-data statement. Select Save draft or Submit for intake validation. Files must complete managed upload and clean-scan checks before submission. Do not include patient identifiers, PHI or unnecessary personal data. Assembly cases is a list of included cases and retained historical requests; new standalone assembly purchases are not created from that list. If the Assembly cases list is empty, select Open PSeq Kit orders to find the included case. Prepare inputs becomes available after its kit is shipped.

sections.heading: Submit and correct
sections.text: Submission freezes an immutable input revision. Phaeno validates the input and may request field- or file-specific changes or reject it with a Partner-visible reason. Valid included work proceeds to the processing queue without a second quote or purchase. If changes are requested, open Edit request. Input files shows every saved input and its scan result. Use Remove input to exclude an incorrect or failed-scan file from the editable revision, then select its replacement. Removing a current input preserves earlier submitted revisions. Review the profile's file types and per-file/total limits before uploading. Save the draft or submit the corrected revision. A failure after draft creation retains the same request. Successfully uploaded files remain listed; retry resumes the remaining work. Open saved draft returns to the saved record when final submission has not succeeded. Earlier revisions remain preserved for traceability.

sections.heading: Historical standalone requests
sections.text: Earlier standalone assembly requests retain their original per-job quote, PO, approval and commercial history. Their existing quote controls remain available when applicable. Those historical terms do not introduce another quote or sale for a purchased Kit case.

sections.heading: Track and download outputs
sections.text: The request shows intake review, queued work, processing, output review, output availability, holds, and completion. An approved output release contains an immutable manifest and one or more checksummed files tied to the source input revision and assembly profile. For included cases, scientifically ready outputs use the original Kit shipment commercial source and the Partner assembly-credit or recorded-payment decision. No second invoice, commercial source or sale is created. Credit-approved Partners may download under their approved credit terms. Partners whose original purchase has neither approved assembly credit nor sufficient recorded payment can see that outputs are ready but cannot download them; contact Phaeno about the original Kit payment or credit decision. Use Download package to retrieve every file in a release as one ZIP, or download a file individually. Only a complete server response counts. Partial, cancelled, failed, and timed-out transfers remain undownloaded, and an active transfer is shown as in progress until it reaches a terminal outcome. One completed download by any currently authorized Partner member satisfies that file for the organization; the Partner view does not expose the member's identity. Each newly released output shows the retention schedule frozen when that release became available. Standard deletion is the normal deletion time. Conditional grace through applies only when at least one file in the release remains undownloaded at the standard deadline; when that happens, the whole release receives the displayed grace period. Dates and times include the browser's local time-zone label. An earlier output created before retention snapshots were introduced does not show a schedule; contact Phaeno before relying on a deletion date for that release. A corrected output is a new release. Partner users download the release and deliver it through their own customer process; Portal does not collect the Partner’s end-customer identity or deliver directly to that customer. Use the available withdrawal or cancellation-request action on the request. Phaeno records unused-case cancellation from the Kit order; completed work and the original purchase history remain preserved. Where retention enforcement is enabled, file and ZIP requests close at the same frozen deadline. Grace period active keeps an incomplete release available through its stated final date; later completion does not shorten grace. A transfer admitted before cutoff may finish within its original time limit. File withdrawal, a failed scan, or removal of your access can stop an active ZIP. A failed ZIP counts none of its files from that attempt, while earlier successful downloads remain. Closed download controls do not indicate physical deletion. The page refreshes availability after an unsuccessful attempt. If timing cannot be verified, contact Phaeno; do not infer new dates for earlier releases without a schedule. These rules do not bypass payment holds or scientific release approval. Where scheduled retention notices are enabled for Assembly releases, active Organization admins receive one download reminder for an incomplete release and one grace notice if grace applies. A delayed reminder is skipped if every file has completed or the standard deadline has passed. There are no daily reminders. Notices identify the release and deadline and link to the authenticated assembly request; open it for current availability. Delivery problems do not extend the dates. Contact Phaeno if a notice needs support. Notices follow your Partner organization's admins and do not go to its end customers.

sections.heading: Keep an output receipt
sections.text: Open View retained package receipt beside an output's retention schedule and select Print / save PDF. The retained receipt lists every file, size, checksum, original deadline, recorded completion and deletion facts, and reissue links. It holds metadata, not downloadable copies. Times show the display time zone and UTC. Assembly outputs are identified as project-level files; the receipt does not infer sample mappings from the scientific manifest. Organization admins may review the organization's downloader history. Other members see authorized release facts within their Department. A quarantine stops downloads; a preservation hold does not extend the deadline. Contact Phaeno for support or an authorized reissue after deletion. Reissue requires a newly prepared, approved package and preserves the earlier receipt and dates.

sections.heading: Find and resume requests
sections.text: If accepting a quote, withdrawing, or requesting cancellation fails, review the message in the open dialog. Your entries remain available to correct and retry. Closing the dialog does not confirm the action. You are asked before discarding changed entries. While saving, the dialog stays open and its entries and actions are unavailable until the save finishes. Successful changes refresh the request and its status in the list. The list provides search, status/date filters, Submitted by me, total counts, and Previous/Next. Opening a request and returning keeps the filtered page. Clear all removes filters. Failed loads offer retry instead of reporting that no requests exist. Closing a form with unsaved entries asks whether to discard them.

guides.title: Getting started
guides.summary: Find reagent orders, Assembly requests, curated data, and retained Trials in the selected Department.

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.text: Portal gives Partner organizations a workspace for your Partner organization for PSeq Kit orders, Lab Service Jobs, included assembly cases, released outputs, curated data, and organization access.

sections.heading: Navigate the help center
sections.text: Open the user dropdown menu in the toolbar and choose Documentation under Resources. This entry is available on both wide and narrow screens. On smaller screens, the Documentation tab sits below the toolbar and organization details. Guide navigation opens beneath the toolbar from the far-left edge of the screen. Its header identifies Documentation and, on wider screens, provides the pin or unpin icon. Pointer users can preview an unpinned sidebar by approaching the left edge; keyboard and touch users open it from the tab. Choosing a guide closes an unpinned sidebar and displays the article.

sections.heading: Confirm the current Partner organization
sections.text: The header shows the organization active in your current session. Prices, offerings, requests, files, and permissions always come from that organization. A Partner cannot see another Partner’s negotiated prices or work. Self-service switching between multiple external organization memberships is not currently available. If the wrong organization is active, or your account belongs to more than one external organization, contact Phaeno before continuing.

sections.heading: Know your access level
sections.text: Partner organization administrators and department administrators may prepare Kit and Lab drafts, submit included assembly inputs, accept applicable manual quotes or changes, decide substitutions, and request cancellations within their operational Department. Organization and assigned-Department administrators may place configured Lab Service and PSeq Kit purchases or request custom work for that Department. Organization administrators also manage organization-wide invitations and roles. Other active Partner members have read, progress-tracking, and eligible output-download access.

sections.heading: Find your work
sections.text: Dashboard summarizes reagent orders and data-assembly requests, assigned data, and any retained Trial history for the selected Department. Follow its links to the owning records; administrators also have a User management starting point. PSeq Kit orders contains the organization’s available products, drafts, placed orders, substitutions, and shipments. Assembly cases contains included input revisions, processing status and outputs, plus historical standalone requests. Lab services contains Lab Jobs, configured offering reviews, samples, shipping and released PSeq results. See Partner Lab services. Data Library contains Phaeno-curated packages explicitly assigned to the Partner. For organization administrators, User management manages durable invitations, Member or Organization administrator roles, and membership deactivation. Documentation in the user dropdown menu opens the Partner guides.

sections.heading: Protect submitted data
sections.text: The initial workflows are not designed to collect protected health information. Do not place patient identifiers, credentials, or unnecessary confidential information in project names, notes, file names, manifests, or uploads. Use a Partner-controlled project reference and follow the metadata and file requirements shown by the selected assembly profile.

sections.heading: Get help
sections.text: Provide the portal order, request, shipment, or project reference when contacting Phaeno. Never include passwords, authentication tokens, or sensitive file contents in a support message.

sections.heading: Earlier Trial Projects
sections.text: If your organization converted from Prospect, Trial Projects retains the approved Trial history and available results in their original department. Conversion preserves existing download deadlines. See Trial history.

sections.heading: Search and browse guides
sections.text: Use Search documentation at the top of Documentation to find a guide or a matching section. Results update after a short pause; use at least two characters. Try “reagent orders” or “data assembly”. Choose Filters to narrow results by Topic, Workflow, or Guide type. Clear filters removes those selections. Browse by topic opens guides for a topic without requiring search words. Workflow links and Related guides at the end of an article provide other ways to find relevant instructions. Select a result title to open its matching section. Your browser’s Back action restores the search and filters. Search uses the guides for your current organization; it does not include the public Website or operational records. A guide’s instructions do not change your account permissions. If no guides match, try fewer words or clear the filters. If search is temporarily unavailable, use Try again or Browse all guides. A documentation update may require Refresh page; guide browsing remains available while the update finishes.

guides.title: Use Partner Lab services
guides.summary: Complete Partner ordering and shipping on the Job, then track sample receipt and laboratory results.

sections.heading: Additional samples after acceptance
sections.text: Phaeno can issue a separate Change quote for additional samples on an active accepted Job. An organization or assigned-Department administrator reviews the added source counts, incremental charge, tax status and expiry, then accepts with any required purchase order number or declines the addition. The original agreement and existing work remain in effect. Expired or superseded proposals cannot be accepted. After acceptance, add the new samples individually and finalize the list. Previously authorized samples stay locked; only new samples receive additional laboratory and shipping authorization. Laboratory review may block unsafe additions without saving partial work. Completion includes accepted additions in the Job's invoice; declining the proposal does not cancel the Job. When Phaeno records the first container's arrival, the Job shows Received. Individual sample receipt follows verification of actual tubes. A sample shows Accessioned after all its expected tubes across shipments have been accessioned. Partial receipt remains visible while other tubes are outstanding. Receipt does not mean scientific acceptance or analysis has begun. The Job list and header show recorded laboratory progress: Received → Library Prep → Sequencing → Data Assembly → Quality Review → Results Available. In After you send, each stage shows the number of samples currently at that stage. Choose View sample stages to review individual samples. These are current counts, not completion checkmarks; a partial release does not make the whole Job complete. When activity is recorded for the whole Job before individual samples are updated, the page explains that distinction. The Order status filter continues to find commercial stages such as In Progress, On Hold, or Completed. Sequencing requires recorded sequencing activity; shipping to the sequencing provider alone is insufficient. Quality Review includes scientific review and approved results awaiting release. Results Available requires an actual release. Holds, cancellation requests, and completed or cancelled orders retain their visible status. Use Lab services within the selected Department to describe and price a Job before entering its exact sample list. Organization and Department administrators may prepare a Job. An organization administrator or an administrator of the selected Department may place a configured standard order or accept an applicable manual quote.

sections.heading: Follow the Job workspace
sections.text: The Job has two areas. Ordering and shipping shows six horizontal icons: Pricing review (or Confirm pricing when a quote is ready), Sample identification, Container supply, Assign containers, Match samples to tubes, and Send samples. Checkmarks show completed work, the current step is highlighted, and future steps are muted. On a narrow screen, move along the step strip to review the remaining steps. Once transportation kits are ordered and compatible containers are still needed, Your next step reads Wait for containers to arrive. View kit delivery opens the shipping area; the message distinguishes Phaeno preparing the containers from containers in transit. Confirm receipt only after the kits physically arrive. Assign shipping containers appears when compatible received containers are available at the selected container location; previously received stock can be used without waiting for a new delivery. Container location appears with container selection: one active location is shown in a read-only text box, while multiple locations offer a selector. The selector remains available when the selected location has no stock so you can check another location. The kit-order modal separately uses Kit receiving location for the address where new kits should arrive. Hover over an icon, focus it with the keyboard, or tap it to read its detailed explanation and status, including who must act when work remains. Press Escape, move keyboard focus away or tap outside to close the information. Icons provide information; selecting one does not open work or change the Job. This also applies to completed and future steps. Your next step below the icons explains the required task, any prerequisite, and whether it is with you, your administrator, Phaeno or the carrier. Use its action button for the required work on the same Job. The steps reflect saved records; they are not checkboxes to mark yourself. Waiting for pricing or delivery is not a task you must complete personally. Send includes reviewing and confirming the shipping insert, printing its current revision, following the packing instructions, putting the insert inside the correct container, handing the package to the carrier and recording the shipment. Repeat for each required container. Confirming an insert records its revision; opening a print dialog does not prove that it was printed or packed. Send is complete only when every required active shipment has been recorded as sent. The Job's Actions menu gathers eligible commands under This order and Selected shipment, with the selected shipment reference shown when shipping commands apply. One available command may appear directly. Permissions and the current stage determine which commands are available; Members retain review and permitted downloads without administrator actions. Cancellation remains available under its existing rules. After you send shows recorded shipments and tracking, actual receipt, the latest laboratory progress, timing, and released results. Each recorded shipment can move into this area while another container is still being prepared. All required dispatches must be recorded before the shipping steps are complete. A later request for clarification or replacement material remains visible above the work areas; follow the permitted response without reopening a dispatched shipment's tube assignments.

sections.heading: Review an existing Job
sections.text: If Phaeno has prepared a Job after discussing the scope with your organization, it appears in Lab services as Quote in preparation while Phaeno prices it. You do not need to submit that Job for pricing. Open the Job and review its committed sample count, biological-source composition, storage requirements, safety declaration, and notes. When Phaeno issues the quote and it becomes Quote issued, an organization or department administrator can review it in Quote and billing and select Accept quote beside Order details and billing. Phaeno cannot accept it for your organization. If the scope is incorrect, do not accept the quote; contact Phaeno so the Job can be returned for a corrected revision. For a manually quoted Job, individual sample entry remains unavailable until your organization accepts the quote. Lab Service records belong to your Partner organization and selected Department. Do not enter your downstream customer’s identity. Partner Lab results follow the Lab Service workflow described here. Contact Phaeno for billing records. Included Kit assembly cases are managed from their purchased PSeq Kit order.

sections.heading: Submit a lab service request
sections.text: Request lab service is available only while your organization has current ordering authorization and PSeq Lab Service is offered. If new Jobs are unavailable, the page explains whether Phaeno must enable ordering authorization or the service is temporarily unavailable. Existing accepted Jobs remain available and follow their normal hold or cancellation workflow. Open Lab services and select Request lab service. In Submit lab service request, enter a unique Job name and each Biological source with its sample count. The Portal calculates the Job's total sample count from those source groups. Enter the Storage requirements and Safety declaration shared by every sample, and any optional Job notes. Do not enter a patient name or identifier. Select Submit request. The portal assigns an immutable eight-character Job number using unambiguous uppercase letters and numbers. The request opens on its detail page at Pricing review, with Waiting for pricing as its next step. Phaeno prepares pricing for you to accept or decline. Submission does not authorize work; individual sample entry remains unavailable until you accept. Members can review work in their assigned Department. Organization and Department administrators may create, edit, submit and accept applicable manual quotes in that Department. Organization and assigned-Department administrators may also place configured standard orders. Department authority does not grant access to other Departments. If an older draft still contains sample rows from the former workflow, the Job identifies them as legacy rows. Clear each row’s details before submitting for pricing; enter the current sample roster again only after accepting the price.

sections.heading: Existing configured standard drafts
sections.text: For an existing unsubmitted draft with a configured standard offering, in Standard PSeq Lab Service, choose an available Offering. Review its allowed material types and biological sources, included scientific outputs, published turnaround range, sample count, purchased sample-sequencing runs, and price per run. The bundle includes laboratory processing and data assembly; it does not require a separate assembly purchase. Choose Review standard order. The review shows the current subtotal, approved tax, and final total. An organization or assigned-Department administrator supplies a PO when required, confirms the scope and prohibited-data statement, and selects Place standard order. The offering, scope, price and approved tax are retained with the Job. Detailed samples are entered afterward. If a readiness or billing requirement is incomplete, the displayed blockers explain why placement is unavailable. Phaeno must resolve the relevant service, shipping, billing or tax setup. A standard order cannot be committed with an unknown final total. If the offering, scientific definitions, price or organization settings change while reviewing, select Refresh terms and review again and affirm the new terms before placing. Describe any required sources, outputs or timing in the lab service request and its Job notes. There is no separate custom-work inquiry to submit for this Job.

sections.heading: Submit for review
sections.text: New requests are submitted for pricing when you select Submit request. Older unsubmitted drafts can use Actions → Submit for pricing. Do not include patient identifiers, PHI, or unnecessary personal data. No individual sample list is required or permitted at this stage. Submission preserves a pricing-profile revision. Phaeno can prepare pricing, request specific corrections, or reject work that cannot be performed. While Pricing review is pending, use Actions → Edit request to change the scope and select Submit changes, or Actions → Withdraw request to stop the request. Each submitted change preserves the earlier revision and returns the latest scope to Phaeno for pricing. When pricing is issued, the first step changes to Confirm pricing; review the quote and accept or decline it. Direct scope edits are unavailable once pricing is issued. When corrections are requested, create and submit a new revision. The prior revision remains in the job history; it is not silently overwritten.

sections.heading: Review and accept a quote
sections.text: From the Job's Actions, select Download quote PDF to save a Phaeno-branded copy of the displayed quote for your Partner organization. It includes the Job, quote revision and dates, itemized prices, the biological sources and sample counts recorded for that quote, and any billing details and payment terms saved with that quote. Older quotes without a recorded source breakdown omit that table. Members can download quotes for their assigned Department; downloading does not accept a quote. If the download fails, select Download quote PDF again to retry. Laboratory services are priced per job. Phaeno issues an itemized, immutable Portal quote for the accepted scope. When your approved billing and tax information is available, the quote includes calculated tax and freezes those commercial terms. Otherwise the quote is labeled Pre-tax total, and applicable tax is calculated when the invoice is issued. A zero tax amount is valid for an exempt, non-taxable, or zero-rate determination. The quote is available after all non-billing readiness items are complete and a Partner administrator is active; billing must be complete before invoicing. Before accepting, confirm the committed sample count, biological-source composition, standard service scope, price, currency, expiration date, and whether the displayed amount includes tax or is pre-tax. A Partner organization administrator or an administrator of the selected Department can accept the current unexpired quote. If the scope changes after acceptance, Phaeno issues a separate change quote. Added work does not begin until the applicable change is accepted. Use Accept quote and Decline quote beside Order details and billing. Use the Job's Actions for Download quote PDF under This order. Declining a quote closes the entire request; the confirmation explains this before you proceed. Before a quote is available, use Withdraw request to close your request. After acceptance, use Request cancellation for Phaeno review. When declining, choose a reason: Our needs changed, Cost is too high, Selected another vendor, Prefer not to say, or Other. Only Other requires an explanation in the multiline Please explain field. The selected reason is recorded with the request closure. If accepting, declining, withdrawing, or requesting cancellation fails, review the message in the open dialog. Your entries remain available to correct and retry. Closing the dialog does not confirm the action. You are asked before discarding changed entries. While saving, the dialog stays open and its entries and actions are unavailable until the save finishes.

sections.heading: Expired quotes and extension requests
sections.text: An unaccepted Partner Lab Service quote shows Expired and its expiration date once its deadline passes. Accept quote appears beside Order details and billing for organization and department administrators; it is disabled with an explanation when acceptance is unavailable. Members can review and download the quote, and should ask an administrator to accept it. For the current expired quote, an organization or department administrator can select Request quote extension, optionally explain why more time is needed, and submit the request. Extension requested confirms that Phaeno has the request; another request for the same quote is unnecessary. If saving fails, the dialog keeps the entered reason so you can retry. If Phaeno issues a new revision, review its price, terms and new expiration date before accepting. An extension request does not accept a quote or automatically extend its deadline. The original revision remains in the history, and its PDF stays available. An accepted quote remains Accepted when its former expiration date passes.

sections.heading: Ship and track samples
sections.text: After placing the standard order or accepting the manual quote, open Sample identification in Samples and shipping. A blank row is provided for each remaining accepted sample, grouped under its biological source. Enter a unique Sample ID in each row; Tubes starts at 1 and can be changed if that sample includes reserves. Select Save sample IDs for the group. You can save part of a group and return to the remaining blank rows. The counts show saved samples; blank rows are not saved records. If a save is interrupted, confirmed saves remain and unconfirmed entries stay available for review and retry. Use Actions at the right of the Samples and shipping heading for list options. For CSV entry, select Actions → Download CSV template and Actions → Import sample list. Import is available only while there are no saved samples or unsaved entries; discard unsaved entries and clear saved sample details first to start again with a CSV. Once all required sample IDs and tube counts are saved, the menu is replaced by Review and finalize list, and CSV options are hidden. The CSV accepts exactly customer_sample_id, biological_source, and tube_count; it does not accept barcodes. Previewing a CSV does not change the Job. Confirming a valid preview saves the complete list as one operation. Samples are grouped by Biological source. Each heading shows saved and accepted sample counts, including sources with no saved entries yet. These counts measure samples, not tubes. All expected rows are visible during identification. Once the list is complete, saved samples are shown 10 per page with Previous samples, Next samples, and a range such as Samples 1–10 of 18. A group spanning pages repeats its heading and full count. Each saved sample’s Actions menu shows its sample ID in the header. Use Actions → Edit sample or Actions → Clear sample details. The Clear sample details? modal offers Cancel and Clear sample details. Confirming clears the saved ID and tube count while preserving the accepted source and required sample count. A blank required row returns with one tube as its default; complete it again before finalizing. Use Edit sample for simple corrections. Finalized samples retain their existing editing restrictions. The routine Expected lab status is hidden while preparing the list; other statuses remain visible. Sample IDs must be unique within the Job, and tube counts must be positive whole numbers. Do not enter patient names or direct identifiers. The biological source is already supplied by the group. To correct a saved sample, use Actions → Edit sample and choose another accepted source with room only when it accurately describes the sample. Save or discard unsaved IDs before editing saved samples, importing, or finalizing. Leaving with unsaved entries requires confirmation. If an existing group exceeds its accepted count, such as 2 of 1, it shows a red warning. Its samples remain available to review and correct. Edit a sample's source only when another accepted source accurately describes it and has room, or clear an extra entry’s details with confirmation. Samples with a source outside the accepted list are also shown for correction. The list cannot be finalized until its total and every source count match the accepted scope. Do not ship physical samples before the order is commercially committed and the exact roster is finalized. An early or unmatched package is quarantined and escalated by Phaeno; it is not accessioned or attached to active Job work. The final list must contain exactly the accepted number of unique non-PHI sample IDs, match every accepted source-group count, and give each sample a positive whole-number tube count. A green check beside the overall counter means the total and source counts are complete; it does not finalize the list. After saving every required sample ID and matching the accepted source counts, select Review and finalize list at the right of the Samples and shipping heading or in Your next step. Both buttons open the same review. Clearing sample details returns the card to its incomplete-list controls and hides the finalization shortcut until the required details are saved again. The review follows the same biological-source grouping as the sample area. Both views sort sample IDs in natural numeric order within each group, such as TEST-2 before TEST-10. The review shows source counts and the overall sample, allocated run and tube totals. Review every sample and affirm the no-PHI confirmation before selecting Finalize sample list. Finalization authorizes the specimen-specific Lab work and lets Phaeno prepare the registered return kit. Use Prepare containers from the Job's Actions, or use the container preparation area in Samples and shipping, for the tubes awaiting allocation. Review compatible sizes by common name, SKU and usable tube capacity. The recommendation prefers the fewest containers and then the least spare capacity; it does not verify or reserve stock. An organization or Department administrator can open Assign containers to review Containers to use, starting with one row per recommended container. Each row has a compatible size selector, SKU/capacity and tube count. Add container chooses a size for the capacity still needed and assigns the remaining tubes up to its capacity. A row's Remove action removes only that container; changing or removing it preserves the other rows' tube counts. Choices include smaller containers and the smallest size that covers the remaining need, excluding choices that make another selected container unnecessary. With sizes 5/10/20, three remaining tubes offer only a 5. For 30 tubes, 20+10 or six 5s are valid; two 20s are not offered. With 10+5 already selected, Add chooses another 10 and then a 5. Add container is disabled once selected capacity covers all tubes. Use recommendation replaces the current rows and tube counts. Stock requirements apply automatically; there are no manual stock quantities to enter here. Another permitted plan needs no separate approval. Review tubes, containers, usable capacity, spare slots and unallocated tubes. Confirm assignment creates a shipment for each container with allocated tubes. Empty containers are not created. A partly filled container is valid; spare slots are not missing sample tubes. If capacity is insufficient, Confirm partial assignment leaves the exact outstanding tube count visible while preparing allocated tubes. Tubes from a single sample may be split across containers, without changing accepted counts or price. Adjust each row's tube count as needed. Counts must be whole numbers, fit each container and together equal the tubes allocated in the preview. The Summary stays visible while updating; confirmation becomes available when the current allocation has been checked. Use Shipping container in the Job's Samples and shipping area to select this Partner Job's container or remaining tubes awaiting containers. With multiple choices, select deliberately before using a shipment command; one available choice is selected directly. Its reference stays visible in the work area and the Selected shipment action group. Switching container or returning to Samples asks before discarding an unsaved scan and is unavailable while saving. Container, kit and receipt details expands the supporting information without narrowing the scanner. Before scanning starts, an organization or Department administrator can use Reset container configuration in Container, kit and receipt details. Review the confirmation: it returns all containers and tubes for the Partner Job to selection, not just the shipment you opened. The finalized sample list stays intact; previous configurations remain in the records and audit history for support. Retired configurations stay out of normal container choices; an older direct link identifies them as history. Cancelling changes nothing. Reset container configuration is unavailable while a barcode entry is unsaved or saving; discard an unsaved entry before revising the plan. Any saved scan, linked physical kit, shipping insert, dispatch or receipt anywhere in that Job's shipment plan locks the action. Clearing a scan does not restore it. If work starts while confirmation is open, the change is rejected; refresh and review the current state. A successful change preserves the accepted quote, kit orders and physical inventory. Use Match tubes in Samples and shipping or the Job's Actions to match registered tubes in the selected container. One scan field opens inside the active tube row in the expanded sample. Container identity and overall progress stay above the list. For the displayed sample and tube number, scan its permanent barcode and press Enter or Save scan. Each match is saved separately before the next sample and tube are revealed. A successful save updates the barcode and progress, expands the next unmatched tube’s sample, scrolls its row into view and focuses its inline scan field. Failed, unknown, ineligible, duplicate and already-used scans retain the entered barcode and current target for review and retry. The first saved match locks container reset. Expand a sample to review its individual tubes, saved barcodes and container identities. The list keeps 10 samples per page; there is no separate Scan tubes view. While matching, saving reveals the next unmatched tube's sample and page. Reviewing another page or expanding a different sample does not change the active scan target or entered barcode. Return to active tube restores its sample and inline scan field, including the unfinished barcode. No barcode field is shown while the active sample is collapsed or on another page. The scan progress applies to the selected container; each sample's matched count covers all its active containers. Done scanning appears at the right of the Samples and shipping heading only after every tube in the selected container has a saved match. Leaving or changing containers preserves the existing unsaved-scan warning. Paging and dismissal are unavailable while saving. After the last match, the field closes and the same list remains open for review. Use tubes from a fulfilled kit registered for this Partner Job. The first successful scan associates that physical kit with the shipping container; its other tubes must come from the same kit. Do not cover or alter permanent tube barcodes. Change tube or Correct tube requires a correction reason and preserves history. A correction to a confirmed shipping insert before dispatch voids the old revision and issues a corrected one; destroy unused old copies. The Job's Actions menu groups shipping commands under Selected shipment and applicable pricing, withdrawal and cancellation commands under This order. The selected shipment reference identifies the container affected. If only one command is available, it appears directly. Your permissions and the complete shipment's stage determine availability, including Review and confirm shipping insert, Review packing instructions, Print shipping insert, Download tube list (CSV) and Record shipment. Completing one visible page does not complete a whole container. Authorized readers retain print and download access. Print one receiving sheet for each physical container and place it inside that container. It shows the Customer, Job/Trial and shipment references, sample and tube totals, essential handling notes and two widely separated scan targets: the large Scan to receive this shipment PH-P- insert barcode and, when assigned, the physical container barcode. Follow the full preparation and packing instructions in the Portal before shipping. Follow the approved temperature-control method, amount and packing steps for the actual container. Instructions may call for regular ice, dry ice, cold packs, another method or no cooling. Do not substitute methods or multiply the amount by the number of samples. Contact Phaeno if the instructions are missing or conflict. Full packing instructions and sample / tube list on the insert page retains the confirmed manifest, every sample and tube barcode, and split-sample references; these details do not print with the receiving sheet. Use Download tube list (CSV) to retain the complete crosswalk. When Send is current and the selected shipment's insert is ready, Your next step offers Review packing and print. It checks the current revision and displays the saved destination, common steps, sample requirements and actual container’s packing instructions. Review the cooling method and amount, then select Print shipping insert. The browser print dialog opens while keeping the Job page, selected container and saved matches intact. After the dialog returns, explicitly confirm that the current insert was printed and placed in its container only when you have done both. Cancelling printing, dismissing that confirmation or a print error does not acknowledge the work. If the insert cannot be checked, review the message on the Job, reconnect if needed and select Try again. Insert-confirmation failures keep the dialog entries available. After your printing-and-packing confirmation, the next-step button becomes Record shipment. Your confirmation is remembered in this browser tab for this shipment's current insert. A corrected insert must be printed and confirmed again. You must still record the shipment after carrier handoff. With several shipments, deliberately select the container you are working on. A sole available container remains selected directly. Reopen Actions → Review packing instructions at any time. Reprint through Actions for another copy of the current revision; reprinting does not issue a new revision. Retain the shipping insert or use Download tube list (CSV) for your organization's sample records. After handoff to the carrier, use Record shipment for each container's carrier, tracking number and shipment time. After you send shows the recorded shipments and their receipt progress while other containers may still need preparation. A sample stays partly received until all its expected tubes are recorded; container arrival and individual tube accession are separate laboratory steps. Work stays on the Job. Existing standalone shipment bookmarks remain available, and retained Trial shipping keeps its existing entry point. After finalization, each sample's Matched count shows saved tube matches across its active shipments. Expand the sample to review its tubes and their containers. Once a shipment is sent, tubes are received, or laboratory progress is recorded, the row also shows relevant Receipt and laboratory details. Receipt means actual tubes recorded as received, such as 1 of 4 tubes received; matching barcodes does not establish receipt. These counts cover the whole sample even when its tubes are split across containers. Accession details and review reasons remain visible when present. Checking... means information is loading; Not available means it cannot currently be shown, not that the count is zero. After you send shows the latest recorded laboratory milestone, timing, holds and released results. This is current progress, not a checked history of every scientific stage. A Job can remain in progress while different samples move through laboratory work. If Phaeno needs replacement material or clarification, the job shows a Partner-safe action and the current schedule health. Internal scientific investigation details are not shown. Ready for release means Phaeno's scientific review is complete and the final deliverable package is complete, checksummed, and malware-clean. It does not mean a file is downloadable until an authorized Result Release Manager publishes that sample. Invoice balance and credit status never gate PSeq result release.

sections.heading: Understand turnaround
sections.text: In After you send, Turnaround and progress shows first receipt, scientific acceptance, the original processing target, current expected completion, laboratory completion, delivery due date, original delivery target, and retained full Portal-delivery time. The published turnaround starts at scientific acceptance, not the day the package first arrives. Receipt-to-acceptance elapsed time remains visible separately. Phaeno may update the expected completion with a recorded reason. The original target remains visible. A later expected date queues a notice; an earlier date updates the Portal. Read the customer-safe explanation and current dates on the Job rather than treating an earlier message as the current schedule.

sections.heading: Cancel work
sections.text: A draft can be discarded before submission. Before Phaeno accepts work, an administrator can cancel eligible scope. After acceptance, submit a cancellation request. Phaeno records whether the request is approved, partially approved, or declined. Any correction to an issued PSeq invoice is retained as an append-only credit, debit, or write-off adjustment rather than editing the invoice.

sections.heading: Find and resume work
sections.text: Search and filter by status, dates, or Submitted by me. Previous and Next show the complete matching result set. From a Job, select Back to lab services to return with the filters and page retained. Clear all removes them. An empty filtered result is distinct from a failed load; use Retry records when loading fails.

sections.heading: What appears at each stage
sections.text: While reviewing an order or quote, Order details and billing stays open. Its heading row shows Accept quote and Decline quote when your permissions and the current order allow those actions. Review the total sample count and the biological-source counts in Quote and billing, alongside the price and expiry. Accepting still opens the confirmation dialog and any required purchase-order entry; selecting the first button alone does not place the order. Expired quotes cannot be accepted, and Members retain their existing review-only permissions. Sample submission and Samples and shipping appear after the order is placed or accepted and sample work becomes relevant. Existing sample records remain available for review. Order details may then be collapsed unless a quote decision is pending. After you send appears when there is recorded shipment, receipt, laboratory progress or released results to track. It stays hidden while you review a quote or prepare unsent samples. For split shipments, tracking can appear for a sent container while the remaining containers still need preparation. Any request for your attention remains visible above the work areas. After a shipment is sent, select its Shipping container in Samples and shipping, then choose Reprint shipping insert. When several containers are available and none is selected, Actions → Select container to reprint insert takes you to the container selector. Reprinting opens the browser print dialog for the current insert without issuing a new revision or recording another shipment or receipt. Portal-generated identifiers now render as QR codes, with the exact identifier printed underneath. Shipping inserts, container labels, kit records and displayed sample/tube identifiers use the same format. Use a QR-capable 2D scanner. Existing manufacturer labels and older printed barcodes remain valid; do not relabel a tube or change its saved identity merely to match the new display. A scan still requires the correct workflow and does not by itself confirm receipt or accession.

sections.heading: Multiple tubes for one sample
sections.text: Pricing counts sample-sequencing runs. Twenty samples sequenced once and one sample sequenced twenty times both count as 20. In the Job profile, leave Sample-sequencing runs blank for one run per sample, or enter the total requested runs. A machine batch is not the pricing unit. After accepting pricing, enter each sample once and allocate its Runs independently of Tubes. Use Edit sample to correct an allocation. The total must equal the purchased run count before Review and finalize list becomes available. The CSV template includes sequencing_runs; an older three-column CSV defaults each sample to one run. Submitted tube counts control shipping, not the price. Extra tubes alone do not authorize extra runs. Existing accepted prices and previously recorded scope are preserved. Phaeno reviews each received tube independently and selects one suitable source. A reserve is used only after the preceding processing attempt is explicitly closed as failed. If no material remains for further permitted analysis, the sample can have a failed processing outcome even though a tube passed receipt checks. Follow the Job's customer-facing progress and any request for additional information. With one container, the tube count is assigned automatically up to its capacity and shown in a read-only text box. Any remaining tubes stay unallocated. With multiple containers, edit the tube counts to split the allocation. Returning to one container restores its automatic allocation. Samples are ordered by ID alphabetically and digit by digit, rather than by numeric value. In the Job, biological-source groups stay together. Tube matching follows that sample order, with each sample’s tubes in tube-number order. Saving a match advances to the next unmatched tube. Sample rows show matching progress as 1 of 1 tube matched or 2 of 2 tubes matched. This includes the tube total, so the row does not repeat a separate quantity while matching status is shown. Long sample IDs wrap; they are not shortened or changed.

sections.heading: Delivery due date
sections.text: The delivery due date is separate from the current expected completion. Phaeno may adjust it with a recorded customer-safe reason; the original delivery target remains visible, and the change queues a notice. A forecast change alone does not move the delivery due date. Results are delivered when data for every in-scope sample has been made available through the Portal; you do not have to download or acknowledge them. Partial results and laboratory completion do not by themselves complete delivery. Standard turnaround remains an operating target unless your agreement explicitly provides a guarantee.

sections.heading: Requesting a specimen pause or resumption
sections.text: An organization administrator or administrator of the assigned Department can open a Lab Job and use Specimen holds. Choose Request pause for the affected sample and enter a reason. Other samples are unaffected. The request immediately blocks new preparation, new sequencing handoffs, new analysis and result release for that sample. Pause requested does not mean an ongoing physical procedure has stopped. Phaeno must confirm a safe pause, including any work already with an external provider. If that procedure cannot pause, its facts can still be recorded; new work and release remain blocked. Use Request resumption when ready. Work remains blocked until Phaeno approves resumption. Other authorization, material, quality and workflow requirements still apply, and approval does not automatically start work. Read Hold history for the recorded reasons and decisions. A hold does not automatically change charges, deadlines or retention dates, and results already delivered remain available. Contact Phaeno directly for an urgent request or a separate commercial or retention adjustment.

guides.title: Order PSeq Kits
guides.summary: Review negotiated Kit bundles, track each shipped unit and prepare its included Assembly case.

sections.heading: Order PSeq Kits
sections.text: Organization and Department administrators prepare PSeq Kit drafts within their selected Department using offerings negotiated for their Partner organization. An organization or assigned-Department administrator may place a new Kit purchase. Each whole kit unit includes one assembly case with a frozen profile and output contract.

sections.heading: Prepare a draft
sections.text: Open PSeq Kit orders and choose Create PSeq Kit order. Add only products offered to the selected Partner organization. Enter quantities that satisfy the offering’s minimum, maximum, and increment rules. Select an active shipping address from the Partner address book. Add purchase and delivery details when known. The purchase-order number and shipping address are required to place the order, but may remain incomplete in a saved draft. Save draft retains Kit lines, purchase-order number, selected shipping address, requested delivery date, and delivery instructions. You can save and resume a draft or create a new draft from a prior order. The new draft uses current availability and pricing rather than copying stale commercial terms.

sections.heading: Place the order
sections.text: Choose Review PSeq Kit order and compare the quantity, per-unit bundle price, included assembly profile and version, number of included cases, PO and delivery details. An organization administrator selects Place PSeq Kit order from this review. Placement revalidates the item, Partner eligibility, quantity, active negotiated price, shipping address, and purchase-order number. The portal then freezes the offering, included profile, price, currency, address, and PO snapshot. If a price or profile changes, refresh the offerings, save changes and review the updated bundle before placing. Portal preserves the actual negotiated price used for the order. Each shipment creates a journal-entry source record for Phaeno Finance; tax, freight, discounts, invoice preparation, and billing-address facts are handled outside the Partner workspace. Placement moves the local order directly into Phaeno review. It does not wait for an external accounting synchronization.

sections.heading: Review substitutions and changes
sections.text: Phaeno cannot fulfill a different reagent without explicit approval from a Partner organization or department administrator. A substitution request shows the original and proposed product and its commercial effect. Declining it preserves the original order facts. Any post-placement revision that increases the total requires Partner-administrator approval before Phaeno accepts it.

sections.heading: Track fulfillment
sections.text: Orders can be partially shipped. Each shipment can show carrier, service, tracking information, quantities, lot, expiration, and packing-slip details. The order keeps shipped and remaining quantities visible, including backordered units.

sections.heading: Use the included assembly cases
sections.text: Open Included assembly cases on the Kit order. Each purchased unit has its own case, kit label, lot, shipment details, current deadline and history. After shipment, select Prepare inputs on the intended case. The case uses the included profile and outputs from purchase even if the current catalog later changes. See Included assembly inputs and outputs. Unused cases expire 90 days after the kit's labeled expiration, or 12 months after shipment if no expiration was recorded. Phaeno may grant a recorded extension or replace a kit. A replacement transfers the same case to the replacement kit; it does not create another included case or sale. An expired or cancelled unused case does not automatically create a refund. The order's operational summary distinguishes Kit fulfilled / assembly pending from completed assembly. Shipping completion alone does not mean the included outputs are released. For scope outside the offering, an organization or assigned-Department administrator can select Request custom work from the list or order. Describe the need without PHI or a downstream customer identity. A Sales reference confirms the request; the original Kit order remains unchanged and no new purchase is made.

sections.heading: Cancel eligible work
sections.text: A draft or an unaccepted placed order can be cancelled. After Phaeno accepts the order, submit a cancellation request. Shipped quantities are never erased, and approved commercial changes remain in the order history and manual accounting source records.

sections.heading: Resume after a problem
sections.text: If cancellation cannot be saved, review the message in the open dialog. Your reason stays available to correct and retry; closing the dialog does not cancel the order. You are asked before discarding a changed reason. While saving, the dialog stays open and its entries and actions are unavailable until the save finishes. Successful changes refresh the order and its status in the list. If placement fails after a draft was saved, the page identifies that saved draft and provides Open saved draft. Retry continues that same order. An interrupted creation is recovered before a new draft can be created by the same form. Closing with unsaved entries asks whether to discard them. Search, status/date filters, Submitted by me, and Previous/Next apply to the complete matching list. Returning from an order preserves the filtered page. Use Clear all to reset filters or Retry records after a failed load.

guides.title: Statuses and troubleshooting
guides.summary: Interpret reagent, assembly, commercial, scan, shipment, and release states.

sections.heading: Statuses and troubleshooting
sections.text: Partner work has separate operational, commercial, file-scan, and release statuses. A completed workflow does not by itself mean every file is downloadable.

sections.heading: PSeq Kit order statuses
sections.text: | Status | Meaning and next action | | --- | --- | | Draft | An administrator can continue editing or discard the order. | | Placed or under review | Phaeno is validating the frozen order and commercial terms. | | Accepted or processing | Phaeno accepted the order and fulfillment is underway. | | Partially shipped | Review shipments and the quantities still open or backordered. | | Shipped | All current quantities have shipment records; use the tracking details shown. | | On hold | Read the Partner-safe reason and complete the requested action. | | Cancellation requested | Phaeno is reviewing the request; shipped work is not erased. | | Fulfilled | Fulfillment is complete. | | Cancelled or rejected | The order will not proceed. Review the history and any commercial adjustment. | A proposed substitution is a separate decision. A Partner administrator must approve it before Phaeno can replace the ordered reagent. A declined substitution preserves the original order facts.

sections.heading: Assembly request statuses
sections.text: Draft is editable. Submitted and Intake validation mean Phaeno is checking the frozen input revision. Changes requested requires a corrected revision. Quote in preparation and Quote issued apply to retained standalone requests. Included Kit work skips another quote. Placed/queued, Processing, and Output review track work. Output available means an output exists but it may still have a release or payment gate. On hold, Cancellation requested, Completed, Cancelled, and Rejected describe the remaining outcomes.

sections.heading: Included case statuses
